description: Land Title Settlement Department - Inamaluwa, Dambulla D/S Division, Matale District - Cad. Map No. 310009
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act, No. 21 of 1998. It contains declarations of determination by the Commissioner of Title Settlement regarding specific land parcels, including their registration numbers, extents, ownership details, and title classifications. The content appears in "PART III - LANDS" of the gazette and focuses on land ownership determinations, making it clearly fall under the Land Gazettes category (Type 4).
